Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Computer Science BS at Caltech

What Caltech asks of applicants to Computer Science BS for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Caltech courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 6 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • SAT or ACT required — first-year applicants, fall 2027 entry
  • ACT writing and science subscores not required
  • No minimum (cut-off) score

Caltech publishes score ranges of typically successful applicants and uses score “buckets” in review; these are not minimum requirements.

Verified19 Oct 2026Caltech: Standardized Tests
English language
  • English proficiency test required for international applicants unless English is your native language or the primary language of instruction at your secondary school
  • Strongly recommended for non-native English speakers at English-medium schools
  • Accepted tests: Duolingo English Test, IELTS, TOEFL — taken before the application deadline
  • Stated minimums (total / each area): IELTS 7 / 7; TOEFL taken before Jan. 21, 2026: 100 / 25; TOEFL taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026: 5 / 5; Duolingo 130 / 130
Verified19 Oct 2026Caltech: International Applicants
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

Required testing is the SAT/ACT (plus English proficiency for international applicants); no course-specific admissions test is listed.

Verified19 Oct 2026Caltech: Application Requirements
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: to prepare for the core curriculum, students must demonstrate mastery in four years of math including one year of calculus, one year of physics, one year of chemistry, four years of English, and two years of history and/or social sciences (3+ recommended); one year of biology is recommended. Where calculus, chemistry or physics is unavailable, Caltech accepts set AP/IB scores or a Schoolhouse.world course challenge instead. These apply to all first-year applicants — Caltech admits to the Institute and students declare a major at the end of the first year.

A-Level requirements
Grades

For students in the GCE A-Level curriculum, Caltech requires A-Level Maths. Transcripts should show predicted grades where applicable.
Verified19 Oct 2026Caltech: International Applicants
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
For students in the IB curriculum, Caltech requires Higher Level Math. All IB examinations taken must be reported (self-reported), whatever the score.
Verified19 Oct 2026Caltech: International Applicants · Caltech: Standardized Tests
Other qualifications
  • All AP (and IB) examinations taken must be reported, whatever the score — self-reported; official scores only after enrolling
  • A score of 5 on set AP exams (or 6–7 on set IB exams) can substitute for an unavailable calculus, chemistry or physics course

Partly verified: the AP/IB substitution page still refers to “in-coming fall 2026 first-year applicants” in places, so the substitution rule is not confirmed for fall 2027 entry. The AP/IB reporting rule is on the undated testing page.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Caltech: Standardized Tests · Caltech: Academic Requirements for First-Year Applicants
Other requirements
  • Caltech-specific supplemental essays required (STEM academic interest question, short essays)
  • InitialView conversation: recommended, not required, for international applicants
  • Supplemental materials (e.g. research paper, portfolio): optional
